_note: cognipace-abid (19 Nov 2026): milestones, not prizes. An adult's reward is the thing itself - the record, the lab, the exam. Each unlock names the next physical step the plan needs, so it arrives on time: kind module = when that module is passed; streak = days in a row (one free day a week, as hers); level = XP ladder (lib/rewards.js LEVELS).

unlocks.title: Tools in hand
unlocks.reward: Order the second laptop (the Marketplace spec in the plan): it arrives for Phase 2, when Linux goes on bare metal.
unlocks.details: SETUP1 passed means the repo, TryHackMe and the toolchain exist. The laptop is the next physical prerequisite; buying it after SETUP1 and before LNX2 is the plan, not a treat.

unlocks.title: First real program
unlocks.reward: Pin the sec-lab repository on your GitHub profile and write the profile README (name, what you are building, the gates).
unlocks.details: The record becomes public-facing the day there is something in it.

unlocks.title: Two weeks
unlocks.reward: A used copy of 'The Linux Command Line' (Shotts) or the free PDF from linuxcommand.org - the reference for LNX1/LNX2.
unlocks.details: Free online by the author; paper if you want it on the desk.

unlocks.title: The plumbing
unlocks.reward: Subscribe (free) to the Bank of Canada and Payments Canada newsletters; add the BIS 'Annual Economic Report' tokenization chapter to your reading list for FIN5.
unlocks.details: Primary sources, on a schedule, from here on.

unlocks.title: Three tools
unlocks.reward: Buy the Security+ (SY0-701) exam voucher when Phase 3 starts and put the exam date (about week 18) in the calendar.
unlocks.details: A booked date is the pressure you asked for. The study guide of your choice (Chapple & Seidl or Messer's free videos) comes with it.

unlocks.title: Thirty days
unlocks.reward: One month of TryHackMe Premium - for the Jr Penetration Tester path and the Windows rooms in Phase 3.
unlocks.details: Only when the free rooms are exhausted; the streak proves they will be used.

unlocks.title: Shell fluent
unlocks.reward: Install Ubuntu 24.04 on the second laptop - LNX2 opens with the install as its first step.
unlocks.details: The tool is handed over the day its module opens.

unlocks.title: The book is yours
unlocks.reward: A paper-trading account on a broker's simulator (free; no funding) for the journal - mechanisms, never advice.
unlocks.details: Paper only for the whole programme. Real money decisions are yours, outside it.

unlocks.title: Shell Walker
unlocks.reward: A Raspberry Pi 5 (8 GB) with a case and SD card: the always-on lab box for the Wazuh SIEM in Phase 3.
unlocks.details: Arrives when Phase 3 needs a second machine that stays on.

unlocks.title: A hundred days
unlocks.reward: Decided at the time - something the next phase needs.
unlocks.details: By day 100 the plan will say what the gap is.
